title: GDD T-112b — MECH_09 ¡IGUALA! cooperative color-relay (§4) [split from TASK-041]
description:
Split slice 2 of TASK-041. Implement MECH_09 ¡IGUALA! on the canonical v2 IMicrogame contract (engine-free Core, injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick, difficultyScaling, MechanicParamSchema entry, TASK-030 validator entry, mutation-proven zero-alloc sensor) — mirror the shipped MECH_01/02/03/06/07 quality bar exactly.

Mechanic (GDD §4 MECH_09): colorRelay COOP — colored symbols appear in a sequence; ONLY the owner of that color may confirm it, within reactWindow(n) = max(0.45, 0.9 − 0.05·n) seconds (window tightens as the relay progresses, floored at exactly 0.45 s). A wrong-owner confirm costs −1 common progress WITH correct attribution of who erred (surfaced in result/event data). Generated sequences NEVER repeat the same color 3× consecutively. Diagonal inputs collapse to cardinal via the existing TASK-023 diagonal helper. simonSolo is the competitive variant. Coop payout identical for all (P2). Read GDD §4 MECH_09 + §7 + the TASK-023 diagonal helper before coding.

Balance knobs (base reactWindow, decay rate, floor, sequence length, difficultyScaling) are definition data passing the validator. Tests-first (tdd). Fast-suite testable (engine-free); no Unity gate.
acceptance_criteria: MECH_09 implements the v2 contract engine-free, seeded, zero-alloc steady Tick with a mutation-proven zero-alloc sensor; determinism lock (same seed => byte-identical)
Generated sequences never repeat a color 3x consecutively (property test over many seeds)
reactWindow(n) = max(0.45, 0.9 − 0.05n) decays to a floor of EXACTLY 0.45 s (boundary test at the flooring n)
A wrong-color/wrong-owner confirm subtracts exactly 1 common progress and attributes the erring author correctly in the result/event data (tested)
Diagonal inputs collapse via the TASK-023 helper; only the color's owner can advance the relay (non-owner confirm does not advance); identical coop payout to all (P2)
Balance knobs are definition data passing the TASK-030 validator; difficultyScaling applied; tests-first; full fast suite green after, no regression

comments.body:
CLOSED (loop iter 3, TASK-041 slice 2/4) — tdd, depth FULL. All 6 ACs met; fresh-context review rev-t077 APPROVE-WITH-NITS (no HIGH / no MEDIUM); orchestrator fast-suite gate independently 799/0.

DELIVERY: MECH_09 ¡IGUALA! coop color-relay on the v2 contract (engine-free, injected SeededRandom, zero-alloc Tick). Commits: 6e701bd (fast tests, genuine compile-red) / a19f1f1 (feat: IgualaMicrogame/Params + IgualaBotPolicy + MicrogameId.Iguala + schema) / 2b07d14 (Editor .meta sidecars) / 7934712 (fix-round: LOW-1+LOW-3). Fast 779->799 (+20 across delivery+fix, 0 regressions).

REVIEW (all verified firsthand, non-vacuous): AC2 no-3x-consecutive enforced by construction (one RNG draw/symbol via PickExcluding), property-swept 500 seeds + idle-color-never-generated (draws only from _engagedColors); AC3 reactWindow floor EXACTLY 0.45 at n=9 boundary (n=8->0.5, n>=10 stays 0.45, never negative); AC4 wrong-owner -1 proven after driving progress to a real 2, specific named errer attributed 3 ways (LastErringSeat + GetErrorCount + CueWrongOwner FeedbackEvent), floors at 0; AC5 non-owner doesn't advance + REAL TASK-023 CollapseDiagonal call-through + P2 identical payout (Ranks.Length==0 structural, ApplyCoop identical + never-zero on success AND timeout); zero-alloc sensor mutation-proven (seqLen=100 keeps timeout-retry branch running the whole window); anti-cheat clean (bot reads only BotView); no existing test weakened (additive MicrogameId.Iguala=8/schema/csproj only).

FIX ROUND (7934712, comment+test only — verified zero production-logic change): LOW-1 corrected a factually-wrong IgualaParams docstring (default seqLen=8 reaches reactWindow(7)=0.55s, NOT the 0.45 floor which needs n>=9/seqLen>=10). LOW-3 parameterized the diagonal call-through test across ALL 4 zones; dev mutation-verified by bypassing InputInterpreter.CollapseDiagonal hysteresis — Up/Down cases correctly FAILED, Right/Left coincidentally PASSED (exactly the cold-start-fallback coincidence rev-t077 identified), so AC5's diagonal-via-TASK-023 proof is now non-vacuous for every zone.

DEFERRED LOW nits: LOW-2 same-tick same-zone seat-order bias (lower-seat non-owner processed before true owner on an exact-tick collision — the documented [ASSUMED#7] one-confirm-per-tick simplification, rare at 60Hz+debounce); LOW-4 determinism test is result-only not byte-identical dump (acceptable: minimal deterministic RNG).

[ASSUMED] for ratification list (GDD-silent, all reviewer-judged defensible): pure timeout costs nothing (only an active wrong confirm fouls — GDD names exactly one foul; round still capped by DurationSeconds->CoopFail); N/E/S/O->color mapping arbitrary (Up=Rojo/Right=Azul/Down=Amarillo/Left=Verde; Core has no cabinet geometry) with owner=own seat index; simonSolo competitive variant OMITTED (schema reserves a 'mode' param; no AC names it); inactive-zone press is a no-op not a foul (GDD wording admits a stricter reading — worth a one-line human confirm); difficulty divides the effective base window; sequenceLength default=8. Coop-abandonment reuses the MECH_08 IsEngaged predicate (idle/empty colors never generate).
